• Bakery, dairy, sugar mill, café, ice cream parlor and more

A HUGE WORLD

• Meadows, a flower valley, an old forest, a lakeshore and a quarry
• Paths, fences, ponds and over 40 decorations

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
